cohort: 1,387 HIV-positive pregnant women and 1,377 HIV-exposed infants in eight counties across China between 2004 and 2011
finding: The study found that vertical transmission of HIV declined from 11.1% in 2004 to 1.2% in 2011, with increasing HIV screening, ARV prophylaxis, and multi-ARV treatment during pregnancy being associated with this reduction.
mod_finding: Women who had a vaginal delivery were more likely to transmit HIV to their newborns compared to those who had an emergency cesarean section.
